title: Beyond the 956: Two 13-year-olds charged after fair swing ride spins out of control in Georgia
excerpt: Two 13-year-olds are facing unruly juvenile charges after allegedly causing chaos on a swing ride at the Columbia County Fall Fair in Grovetown, Georgia, on Saturday, November 7. The ride reportedly destabilized and injured three people, including a woman taken to the hospital by ambulance.
content:
🌎 BEYOND THE 956

Two 13-year-olds are facing unruly juvenile charges after allegedly causing chaos on a swing ride at the Columbia County Fall Fair in Grovetown, Georgia, on Saturday, November 7.

According to the Columbia County Sheriff’s Office, the teens ignored repeated warnings from fair staff and intentionally grabbed onto each other’s swing seats, locking them together while the ride was in motion.

As the ride began slowing down, their actions reportedly caused the swings to collide violently, destabilizing the ride and injuring three people. One woman was transported to the hospital by ambulance, while two children were treated for minor injuries.

Both teens were issued paperwork detailing their charges and released to their parents’ custody. Their names have not been released because they are minors.

The teens are presumed innocent until proven guilty.

Sources: WorldStar (@worldstar), reporting the Columbia County Sheriff’s Office; WRDW (News 12 / NBC 26).
